# Arctic Today

> > Arctic Today is the world's leading independent news source covering Arctic innovation, geopolitics, industry, and environmental change across the circumpolar North.

Arctic Today provides comprehensive coverage of Arctic regions including Greenland, Alaska, Russia, and Nordic countries, with a focus on geopolitical developments, resource extraction, military activities, and climate-driven ecosystem changes. The site combines independent journalism with B2B advertising services through Arctic Studios.

## Key Topics

- Arctic geopolitics
- Greenland sovereignty
- Arctic oil and gas
- Russia military
- Nordic countries
- Alaska Arctic
- Climate change
- Arctic ecosystems
- U.S.-Arctic policy
- Independent journalism
- Arctic news
- Regional coverage
- Circumpolar North
